gitCommit.subject: P0: close live cross-tenant authz holes in the API (purses-uxh) (#196)
gitCommit.body:
P0: close live cross-tenant authz holes in the API (purses-uxh) (#196)

* docs(purses-uxh): P0 authz hotfix plan (guard under src/server/dal)

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 4.8 <noreply@anthropic.com>

* feat(purses-uxh): requireApiCollectionAccess member-or-owner API guard

* fix(purses-uxh): scope+authorize collection invitations (token leak / self-invite)

* fix(purses-uxh): authorize session before recording decisions (cross-tenant write)

* fix(purses-uxh): authorize collection on session create/list

* fix(purses-uxh): authorize session's collection on get/update/delete

* fix(purses-uxh): authorize collection on item list/create

* fix(purses-uxh): set-hero verifies item/photo belong to collection + access

* fix(purses-uxh): members/[mid] belongs-to-parent + guard GET

* fix(purses-uxh): sort pages verify session belongs to the resolved collection

* fix(purses-uxh): guard collection-scoped session routes (list/create/active) + set-hero test assertion

Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 4.6 <noreply@anthropic.com>
